premises.text: Cancer patients at home between treatments lack monitoring of blood counts and vitals, so infections cause hospitalizations and delayed chemo; current home methods miss critical health information
premises.evidence_span: Current methods of monitoring patients at home are missing critical health information

premises.text: An implanted smart chemo port with microelectronics and optical sensors plus ML software detects early infection via blood-cell, heart, and vitals changes and alerts physicians with longitudinal home data
premises.evidence_span: implanted smart port that detects early signs of infection by measuring changes in blood cell counts, heart function, and vitals

premises.text: Go-to-market sells the technology to port manufacturers
premises.evidence_span: GoToMarket focuses on selling the technology to port manufacturers

premises.text: Commercialization path includes patent applications, verified CPT reimbursement codes, and an anticipated FDA 510K for hardware and software
premises.evidence_span: we've submitted several patent applications, verified CPT codes for reimbursement. Based on predicates, we have a clear roadmap to our FDA submission and anticipate a 510K for the hardware and the software
